scope: Actual stock instructions; supplied RAM, GPIO and peripheral state; no physical radio or battery model

checks.usb_notification: USB states 5/6 send 01; all other states 0..6 send 02
checks.short_status: Incomplete b6 packets leave the public state unchanged
checks.startup: PD1 high 2000 ticks, low 3000 ticks, then receive setup with 3 retries remaining
checks.spi_configuration: Slave mode 0; idle FIFO enabled; active FIFO disabled and both DMA requests enabled
checks.indicator_channels: Indices 0..4 use the five recovered compare registers at 6000/0
checks.charge_complete: PC13 high with external-power state sets LED2 blue continuously
checks.low_battery: Battery-monitor state 1 with level < 5 drives the same burst on LED2 red
checks.voltage_filter: 50 consecutive LVD-enabled low samples; any high sample resets the counter
checks.incoming_message_does_not_acknowledge: B1/B6/B7/unknown messages preserve pending A1/A7 commands; bytewise and two-byte IRQ batches leave wire packets unchanged
checks.padded_frames: 11- and 16-clock A1 frames acknowledge normally; ten bytes is an RX storage budget
checks.unsolicited_status_transaction: FIFO IRQ parses b6 00 02 and select release rearms reception
checks.release_consumer_system_fifo_transaction: All three complete stock transfers match their source buffers
checks.pairing_command_sequence: Select slot, wait 300 scheduler callbacks, then aa 00 01
checks.command_timeout: 4000 callbacks without completion restart the PD1 reset sequence
checks.spi_error: Read overrun rearms the radio context and marks the generic port for cleanup
checks.low_voltage_transition: Level 5 falls to 4, requests power state 9 and selects the 2.70 V nominal detector threshold
checks.caps_lock: USB: steady red; Bluetooth: timer bit 10 while the 4000-tick indication remains active
checks.low_battery_caps_priority: Low voltage suppresses the Caps Lock writer, preserving the red warning
checks.charging_caps_overlap: The stock paths can enable LED2 red and blue simultaneously
checks.idle_timer: 1200000 nominal half-millisecond ticks: ten minutes, differing from the older Japanese manual
checks.indicator_elapsed_ticks: The actual elapsed-tick routine decrements the 50-tick phase without underflow
checks.radio_elapsed_callbacks: The radio callback decrements once per invocation, even when five elapsed ticks are supplied
checks.connection_ends_pairing_indicator: Public radio state 4 clears the pending blink count
checks.pairing_hold_boundary: Pn+F1/F2/F3 fire when the hold counter exceeds 6000; settings-write routine stubbed, all key/command logic executed
